reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -euo pipefail
local_file=config/local.conf
renames_file=config/renames.conf
tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
awk '
  function trim(s) {
    sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", s)
    sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", s)
    return s
  }
  FNR == NR {
    line = $0
    sub(/#.*/, "", line)
    if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) next
    eq = index(line, "=")
    if (eq == 0) next
    old = trim(substr(line, 1, eq - 1))
    new = trim(substr(line, eq + 1))
    if (old != "" && new != "" && old != new) map[old] = new
    next
  }
  {
    line = $0
    if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ || index(line, "=") == 0) {
      print line
      next
    }
    eq = index(line, "=")
    left = substr(line, 1, eq - 1)
    right = substr(line, eq)
    key = trim(left)
    if (key in map) {
      match(left, /^[[:space:]]*/)
      lead = substr(left, 1, RLENGTH)
      rest = substr(left, RLENGTH + 1)
      match(rest, /[[:space:]]*$/)
      trail = substr(rest, RSTART)
      print lead map[key] trail right
      next
    }
    print line
  }
' "$renames_file" "$local_file" > "$tmp"
cat "$tmp" > "$local_file"
